summary: BI-A73A7DA3 (slice 2 of EP-PORTFOLIO-BUDGET-WIP). EpicPortfolio gains nullable confirmation columns (confirmedById, confirmedByAgentId, confirmationReason, confirmedAt, proposalConfidence) and a new enum EpicPortfolioConfidence (high|low), so an epic's portfolio attribution records who confirmed it, why, and how confident the proposal was. The only writer that fills them is confirm_epic_portfolios, which refuses without a reason and a confirming person. Existing writers (the epic edit form, the ops epics API, auto-intake) are unchanged and leave the columns null, which reads as 'no confirmation recorded'. Additive and non-destructive: no backfill, no existing column changes meaning. Migration: 20260925160000_epic_portfolio_confirmation.

fields.name: confirmedById
fields.reason: The person who confirmed the attribution: a User id from the tool's authenticated context. The design forbids an attribution without an actor, so this is the audit anchor. It is an internal account identifier, not free-text personal data.
fields.provenance: Set only by confirm_epic_portfolios from the authenticated caller; never client-supplied.

fields.name: confirmedByAgentId
fields.reason: The AI coworker that carried the confirmation for the person, when one did, so a delegated confirmation is distinguishable from a direct one.
fields.provenance: Set only by confirm_epic_portfolios from the tool execution context.

fields.name: confirmationReason
fields.reason: Why the attribution is right, stated by the confirming person. Required by the write, so every confirmed row explains itself.

fields.name: confirmedAt
fields.reason: When the attribution was confirmed; distinguishes a confirmed row from a legacy unconfirmed one.

fields.name: proposalConfidence
fields.reason: The confidence of the proposal the person accepted (high or low); null when the person chose a portfolio other than the proposal. Lets a reviewer see which attributions rest on item evidence and which on judgment.
fields.provenance: Derived server-side from the epic's own items at confirmation time; never client-supplied.
